content_of_post_to_answer: Can emotional stress affect physical health?
answer: Emotional stress affects physical health because the body does not truly separate a mental threat from a physical one. Chronic stress keeps systems designed for short-term survival activated, which can influence sleep, immunity, digestion, blood pressure, and pain sensitivity. The overlooked part is that stress is not just something you feel; it is a biological state your body repeatedly practices. A mind under constant strain can train the body to remain on alert even when no immediate danger exists.
